mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_upload_part (session_id, part_number, part_size, part_hash, bucket_name, object_key, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{partNumber}, #{partSize}, #{partHash}, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, 'UPLOADED', #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE part_size = VALUES(part_size), part_hash = VALUES(part_hash), bucket_name = VALUES(bucket_name), object_key = VALUES(object_key), status = 'UPLOADED', update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, part_number, part_size, part_hash, bucket_name, object_key, status, create_time, update_time FROM file_upload_part WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND part_number = #{partNumber}
SELECT id, session_id, part_number, part_size, part_hash, bucket_name, object_key, status, create_time, update_time FROM file_upload_part WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY part_number
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_upload_part WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'UPLOADED'
